name: seams-launcher
description: Seams Launcher - one command, both servers, loopback only. The UI runtime is ZERO-dependency (plain HTML/CSS/JS served by server.mjs, booted by launch.mjs). The one dependency this project carries is the Tauri CLI in devDependencies: build tooling only, never imported at runtime. Commit package-lock.json once generated (Erah's machine) to freeze the exact CLI build.

scripts.tauri:icons: cd tauri && npx @tauri-apps/cli icon src-tauri/icons/icon.png src-tauri/icons
